trailhead.label: Via Pustigost by the bar-trattoria All’arrivo, Stolvizza di Resia, the board’s start

cautions: A steep descent over rocks and gravel to the Potok waterfall.
Short stretches on a quiet tarred road through Zamlin.
Ticks are common in the region: check your dog after the walk.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
